alt: 學生把陽光、水循環與植物根系的知識連成完整圖示，向同學說明溫室中的植物如何生長。
scene_prompt: 融會貫通 means combining different knowledge and ideas into a full, clear understanding. In a modern classroom science project, a student brings together ideas learned from botany, sunlight and the water cycle to explain one flourishing plant in a transparent miniature greenhouse. On the table are three simple pictorial study diagrams—sunlight, water drops, roots—visually connected by arrows into one coherent cycle on a large board, with no words. Classmates now understand the whole relationship. Show synthesis, not merely unrelated objects placed together. Natural anatomy, student exactly two arms and legs, hands connected and naturally pointing; board and model supported realistically; sensible perspective.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration, landscape 3:2, delicate graphite pencil contours, soft watercolor and colored-pencil grain on warm ivory textured paper, restrained natural colors. No text, letters, logos or watermark.
